<DatePicker.Root
  locale="en-US"
  name="due"
  defaultValue="2026-03-14"
  onValueChange={(next: string | null) => setDue(String(next))}>
  <DatePicker.Field aria-label="Due" className="date-field">
    <DatePicker.Segments>
      {(segment) => (
        <DatePicker.Segment
          segment={segment}/>
      )}
    </DatePicker.Segments>
    <DatePicker.Input />
  </DatePicker.Field>
  <DatePicker.Trigger aria-label="Pick a day">
    Pick
  </DatePicker.Trigger>
  <DatePicker.Portal>
    <DatePicker.Positioner sideOffset={4}>
      <DatePicker.Popup className="popup" aria-label="Calendar">
        <DatePicker.Calendar className="calendar">
          <DatePicker.Previous aria-label="Previous month">
            Previous
          </DatePicker.Previous>
          <DatePicker.Heading />
          <DatePicker.Next aria-label="Next month">
            Next
          </DatePicker.Next>
          <DatePicker.Grid>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <DatePicker.Weekdays>
                  {(weekday) => (
                    <DatePicker.HeadCell weekday={weekday}>
                      {weekday.short}
                    </DatePicker.HeadCell>
                  )}
                </DatePicker.Weekdays>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <DatePicker.Weeks>
                {(week) => (
